title: Restore Task schema coverage and local $ref validation
notes: Added schemas/v1/task.json and strengthened scripts/test-json-schema.sh to fail when local $ref targets are missing, with python/python3 fallback.

title: Add a negative fixture for broken local schema references
notes: Added schemas/fixtures/invalid/broken_local_ref_schema.json and extended scripts/test-json-schema.sh to assert missing local $ref detection using the negative fixture.

title: Document schema validation workflow in README
notes: Added a dedicated README schema validation workflow with explicit command sequence and added scripts/test-readme-schema-workflow.sh to keep documented commands aligned with executable scripts.

title: Add CI hook for schema validation script
notes: Updated .github/workflows/ci.yml to run scripts/lint-schemas.sh for schema validation and added scripts/test-ci-schema-validation-hook.sh for deterministic CI hook verification.

title: Add sample valid Task payload fixture
notes: Added schemas/fixtures/valid/task.minimal.json and extended scripts/test-json-schema.sh to validate the fixture against schemas/v1/task.json.

title: Add sample invalid Task payload fixture
notes: Added schemas/fixtures/invalid/task.missing_goal.json and extended scripts/test-json-schema.sh to assert deterministic Task schema rejection for missing required goal.

title: Add deterministic schema lint command wrapper
notes: Added scripts/lint-schemas.sh to deterministically parse all schemas JSON files and run scripts/test-json-schema.sh as a single repo-local lint command.

title: Align protocol docs with schema index coverage
notes: Added scripts/test-readme-schema-index-coverage.sh to verify README schema index coverage matches schemas/v1/schema.json oneOf refs, updated README with an explicit index coverage section, and wired the check into scripts/test-readme-schema-workflow.sh.

title: Add pre-commit check for schema JSON parse errors
notes: Added scripts/pre-commit-schema-json-parse.sh to validate staged schema JSON files and scripts/test-pre-commit-schema-json-parse.sh for deterministic pass/fail smoke coverage.

title: Add lightweight changelog entry format for schema edits
notes: Added schemas/SCHEMA_CHANGELOG.md with required entry fields and scripts/test-schema-changelog-format.sh plus README workflow wiring to keep the format deterministic.

title: Add script smoke test for protoc availability checks
notes: Added scripts/test-proto-availability-smoke.sh to deterministically assert the protoc availability guard in scripts/test-proto.sh and documented the command in README.

title: Define gate checklist for ready-for-review protocol changes
notes: Added checks/ready-for-review-gate-checklist.md and scripts/test-ready-for-review-gate-checklist.sh to define and deterministically validate ready-for-review gate checklist content.

title: Add deterministic validation for self-host run artifacts
notes: Added scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to validate SELF_HOST_MILESTONES/REPORT/UPDATE/IMPLEMENTATION_LOG JSON structure, key order, milestone ordering, and count consistency.

title: Harden self-host artifact checks for milestone continuity
notes: Strengthened scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to enforce contiguous milestone IDs and verify report milestone_completed references an existing done milestone.

title: Cross-check latest self-host implementation log against report files
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to validate latest implementation log field types, require milestone_completed alignment with SELF_HOST_REPORT.json, and require report file lists to be represented in latest log files.

title: Enforce UTC ISO-8601 timestamps in self-host artifacts
notes: Hardened scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to require UTC ISO-8601 timestamps for done milestone completed_at values and latest implementation log timestamp, and added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-timestamps.sh for deterministic regression coverage.

title: Enforce self-host report/update status alignment
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to require report/update status values from pass|fail|blocked and to enforce status equality across both artifacts, with deterministic regression coverage in scripts/test-self-host-artifact-status-alignment.sh.

title: Enforce deterministic implementation log key order validation
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to enforce the latest SELF_HOST_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.json entry key order and added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-log-key-order.sh for deterministic regression coverage.

title: Enforce contiguous done milestone progression
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to fail when any done milestone appears after a pending milestone, and added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-done-prefix.sh for deterministic regression coverage.

title: Require report milestone_completed to match latest done milestone
notes: Hardened scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to require SELF_HOST_REPORT.json milestone_completed to reference the latest done milestone and added deterministic regression coverage in scripts/test-self-host-artifact-latest-milestone.sh.

title: Validate non-empty scalar text fields in self-host report/update artifacts
notes: Hardened scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to require non-empty strings for SELF_HOST_REPORT test_command/note and SELF_HOST_UPDATE headline/current_focus/milestone_target/note, and added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-text-fields.sh for deterministic regression coverage.

title: Enforce summary traceability in latest self-host implementation log entry
notes: Completed by enforcing that the latest SELF_HOST_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG summary explicitly includes milestone_completed id and adding deterministic regression coverage.

title: Enforce report file-list consistency in self-host artifact validation
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to reject duplicate SELF_HOST_REPORT new_files/changed_files entries and overlapping paths, and added deterministic regression coverage in scripts/test-self-host-artifact-report-file-list-consistency.sh.

title: Validate SELF_HOST_REPORT changed_files path existence
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to fail when SELF_HOST_REPORT changed_files includes a missing path, and added deterministic regression coverage in scripts/test-self-host-artifact-report-file-path-existence.sh.

title: Validate SELF_HOST_REPORT new_files path existence
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to fail when SELF_HOST_REPORT new_files includes missing paths, and hardened self-host artifact regression fixtures to stage report-listed files. Added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-report-new-file-path-existence.sh for deterministic regression coverage.

title: Enforce strict integer milestone-count fields in self-host artifacts
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to require strict integer types for SELF_HOST_REPORT/SELF_HOST_UPDATE milestone counters and added deterministic regression coverage in scripts/test-self-host-artifact-milestone-count-types.sh.

title: Add language-agnostic JSON schema validation helper for non-protobuf workflows
notes: Added scripts/validate-protocol-json.sh and scripts/test-validate-protocol-json.sh plus objective_spec fixtures and README workflow coverage so non-protobuf language users can deterministically validate protocol JSON payloads.

title: Enforce deterministic README examples coverage for non-protobuf and protobuf entries
notes: Added scripts/test-readme-examples-coverage.sh and wired it into README workflow validation to deterministically enforce required non-protobuf example entries and protobuf example path coverage.

title: Enforce deterministic synchronization between README example indexes
notes: Added scripts/test-readme-examples-sync.sh and workflow wiring so README.md and examples/README.md stay aligned for required non-protobuf and protobuf example entries.

title: Add deterministic self-host proof manifest validation with explicit reason codes
notes: Added scripts/test-self-host-proof-artifacts.sh and scripts/test-self-host-proof-artifact-reason-codes.sh plus SELF_HOST_PROOF.json to enforce deterministic proof hashes, signature_count checks, and explicit reason codes when proofs are missing.

title: Wire proof manifest validation into the default self-host artifact gate
notes: Integrated fail-fast SELF_HOST_PROOF.json checks into scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh and added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-proof-gate.sh for deterministic regression coverage of missing/empty proof reason codes in the default gate path.

title: Enforce deterministic proof path ordering in self-host proof manifests
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-proof-artifacts.sh to require ascending proofs[].path order with reason_code PROOF_PATH_ORDER_INVALID, and expanded scripts/test-self-host-proof-artifact-reason-codes.sh with an unsorted-manifest regression check.

title: Fail fast when proof manifest task_id does not match active run log task_id
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh with reason_code PROOF_TASK_ID_MISMATCH and expanded scripts/test-self-host-artifact-proof-gate.sh regression coverage for mismatched SELF_HOST_PROOF.json task_id.

title: Add a canonical non-protobuf JSON example and enforce deterministic README/schema validation coverage
notes: Added examples/json/objective_spec.minimal.json, updated README.md and examples/README.md example indexes, and strengthened scripts/test-validate-protocol-json.sh plus README example coverage checks to require this non-protobuf JSON path.

title: Track schema index references to missing local schema files in deterministic checks
notes: Completed by enforcing schema-index oneOf local $ref file existence in scripts/test-readme-schema-index-coverage.sh and restoring the referenced schemas/v1/task.json for deterministic non-protobuf schema-index reliability.

title: Track unresolved legacy .schema.json refs with a deterministic manifest check
notes: Added checks/legacy-unresolved-schema-refs.json plus scripts/test-legacy-unresolved-schema-refs.sh and scripts/test-legacy-unresolved-schema-refs-manifest.sh to deterministically track known unresolved legacy .schema.json refs and fail on manifest drift.

title: Enforce pass-run milestone advancement in the self-host artifact gate
notes: Updated scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh to require pass-status milestone_completed progression over the previous implementation log entry and added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-pass-progression.sh for deterministic regression coverage.

title: Add deterministic self-host command log artifact validation
notes: Added SELF_HOST_COMMAND_LOG.json with deterministic format rules and enforced command-log/implementation-log consistency in scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh with dedicated regression coverage.

title: Add explicit reason-code regression checks for command-log failure modes
notes: Added explicit reason_code outputs for SELF_HOST_COMMAND_LOG.json validation failures in scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh and regression coverage in scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-reason-codes.sh.

title: Validate command-log reason-code regressions in default self-host gate smoke coverage
notes: Added scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-gate.sh to exercise COMMAND_LOG_STATUS_MISMATCH and COMMAND_LOG_INDEX_INVALID through scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh, keeping default-gate diagnostics explicit for non-protobuf verification workflows.

title: Require proof-artifact validation to stay first in self-host command logs
notes: Added COMMAND_LOG_FIRST_COMMAND_INVALID in scripts/test-self-host-artifacts.sh and scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-first-command.sh so self-host runs keep proof-manifest validation as the first deterministic verification step for non-protobuf workflows.

title: Expand command-log gate smoke coverage for verification-order drift
notes: Extended scripts/test-self-host-artifact-command-log-gate.sh to swap the first two recorded verification commands while keeping indices valid, so the default self-host gate now exercises COMMAND_LOG_FIRST_COMMAND_INVALID alongside status and index regressions.

title: Reduce duplicated command-log smoke fixture setup across regression scripts
notes: Next increment: extract shared command-log smoke-test fixture setup so the default-gate and targeted regression scripts stay synchronized without changing verification semantics.
